Playbooks, one-to-many programs, AI-assisted workflows. You don't need to have built them from scratch, but you've worked around them enough to have opinions on what you'd do differently. Half-built process doesn't rattle you. You'd rather fix the documentation than complain about it. You actually like being in a room with customers, and you'll get on a plane for the right one. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover — we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. raw.description:
Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience)

Location: Windsor, UK

Introduction

We’re hiring a Senior Data Protection Engineer to join a global hosting and managed services team. The team runs business-critical, highly regulated systems for organisations around the world, many of them in healthcare, where losing data or failing to recover it is not an option.

This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. You’ll also help shape where data protection services go next, at a time when cyber resilience matters more than ever.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Run the platform globally. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. This covers configuration, upgrades, capacity planning, health monitoring, security hardening and lifecycle management.

  • Set the rules. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls.

  • Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures.

  • Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments.

  • Keep operations healthy. Monitor backup, replication, archiving and restore activity. Fix failed jobs, capacity pressure, performance issues and policy exceptions before they become risks.

  • Prove that recovery works. Plan and run restore tests, disaster recovery exercises and readiness reviews, and keep the evidence that recovery targets and controls are met.

  • Strengthen cyber resilience. Work with security and incident response teams on ransomware readiness, anomaly investigations, clean-recovery planning and privileged-access controls.

  • Build strong governance. Write the runbooks, standards and procedures that define good practice, and help regions and technology teams adopt them consistently.

  • Lead when it counts. Take technical ownership during incidents and service disruptions, and drive root cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.

  • Automate. Use APIs, scripting and orchestration tools to automate routine operations, compliance checks, reporting and workflows.

  • Report clearly. Give regular insight into protection coverage, recoverability, compliance, capacity, platform risk and operational performance.

  • Work across teams. Partner closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk and business continuity colleagues, and take part in a shared on-call rota for critical production services.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

  • A solid track record of engineering and running enterprise-scale backup, recovery and data protection services

  • Extensive hands-on production experience with Rubrik

  • A current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification

  • Experience designing and rolling out data protection policies, standards and operating models across multiple regions

  • A strong grasp of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO and RTO, and recovery validation

  • Hands-on involvement in disaster recovery, cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience initiatives

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes

  • Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment

Benefits & Culture

  • Global reach and visible impact: Your work will directly protect critical services, including healthcare systems that clinicians and care providers rely on every day.

  • Real ownership: You’ll have a strong voice in policy design, retention strategy, cyber resilience, automation and the long-term direction of the service.

  • Collaborative environment: You’ll join experienced engineers and architects who value shared ownership, operational excellence and openly sharing knowledge.

  • Growth and development: You’ll keep developing your skills on an enterprise-grade platform, with support for certifications and continuous learning.

  • Competitive rewards: The package includes market-aligned pay and comprehensive benefits that reflect a senior technical role.

If you want to make data protection dependable at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>OVERVIEW:<br></strong></p> <div>We're looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help build the technology that support Gymshark's global growth. Working with industry best tools including Golang, Event-Driven Architecture, and AWS Serverless technologies such as Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and DynamoDB, you'll design and deliver scalable solutions that support key business priorities. As part of a Tech function you will work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Operations, Platform Engineering and Delivery, playing a key role in building both customer-facing and internal products that drive the business forward.</div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Leading technical implementations of projects to help your team deliver high-quality work on time</li> <li>Using Golang to design, build and maintain APIs, services and integrations</li> <li>Implementing event driven solutions to support critical business processes</li> <li>Creating, maintaining and developing CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Building scalable and valuable software leveraging AWS Serverless technologies such as; Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB</li> <li>Focus on creating testable, maintainable and scalable code, following Engineering standards</li> <li>Following an Agile development approach</li> <li>Maintaining existing services, ensuring a high standard of observability and proactive monitoring, in addition to responding to incidents. (Especially during peak sale periods which is critical to business success!)</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching other engineers</li> <li>Improve engineering standards and best practices</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL NEED:<br><br>Essential Criteria:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must have experience in software engineering and writing production code in Golang or another strict typed language</li> <li>Experience using cloud based serverless services (such as AWS Lamba, Google Cloud Run or Azure Functions)</li> <li>Must have a demonstrable knowledge building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Experience designing, setting up databases as well as have an understanding of relational and non-relational approaches</li> <li>Experience designing, building and maintaining scalable APIs</li> <li>An understanding of Event Driven Architecture concepts</li> <li>Experience using Git and understand branching strategies</li> <li>Experience implementing quality and testing best practices within the services you produce, such as unit testing and contract testing</li> <li>Commercial Awareness and a creative problem solver with the ability to think laterally and understand the cost and value drivers within a competitive business environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>CLOSING DATE: 12th October 2026</strong></p> <p><strong>LOCATION:&nbsp;</strong>Please note this is a hybrid role and requires the successful candidate to attend at least 3 days a week in GSIQ, Solihull, UK.</p> <p><strong>BELONGING AT GYMSHARK.</strong></p> <p>Our mission is to be a place where everyone belongs. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and for us that means we always strive to be as inclusive as possible in all aspects of employment, right from your application. We’re committed to finding reasonable adjustments* for candidates with specific needs or have a disability during our recruitment process, and all applicants will be considered fairly and equally. We do not tolerate discrimination of any kind. *If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment please email <a ----- ----- <p><strong>ABOUT US.</strong></p> <p>We’re here to unite the conditioning community. We believe that putting the sweat in today, prepares us for tomorrow. So, we give people the tools they need to reach further, go faster, be stronger. We celebrate those who show up – for themselves – to be their physical or mental best, whatever that means for them. It’s what we want for our community, and our team. A team that’s growing rapidly around the world. A collective of talented individuals working together to invent Gymshark’s future. Our plans are ambitious, and we’re looking for people who want to join us for the ride – our growth will be your growth.</p> <p><strong>THE PERKS.</strong></p> <p>Standard benefits include:</p> <ul> <li>Performance-based Bonus opportunity</li> <li>Funded Healthcare benefit</li> <li>25 days holiday, additional day for your birthday &amp; Bank Holidays</li> <li>Contributory Employer pension scheme</li> <li>Flexible benefits programme – including salary sacrifice EV scheme, dental insurance, cycle to work, tech scheme, holiday trading</li> <li>Gymshark Employee Discount &amp; long service awards</li> <li>Access to High Street cashback and discounts</li> <li>Financial, Physical and Mental Wellbeing Support</li> <li>Enhanced Family Leave package</li> <li>Life Assurance</li> </ul> <p>Office location specific benefits include (IQ):</p> <ul> <li>Gym Membership to The Lifting Club (LC)</li> <li>Onsite lunch provision &amp; coffee bars</li> <li>EV charge points available</li> </ul> <p><strong>Note:</strong> The bonus program and benefits have certain eligibility requirements. Gymshark reserves the right to amend these programs in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: <p>We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to contribute to cutting-edge Research &amp; Development. As innovators in speech technology, our mission is to Understand Every Voice - a vision that has propelled us to be world leaders of Voice AI. Fuelled by innovation, inclusivity, and a passion for making a global impact through world-leading Speech AI, we're looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Engineer to accelerate our efforts towards exceptional speech solutions.</p> <p>Our Modelling Team trains diverse models, including large self-supervised ones, supporting Speechmatics towards being the most accurate speech recognition system globally. It also ensures their deployment into production, working with the latest developments in ML, but also with the best engineering practices for software engineering and model serving.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work on complex R&amp;D projects, with a diverse group of engineers, to achieve ambitious goals.</li> <li>Stay current with the latest developments in Machine learning.</li> <li>Execute high-impact projects to ensure team success.</li> <li>Work collaboratively across departments and mentor team members (where appropriate).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we are looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated experience in collaboratively pursuing ambitious&nbsp;R&amp;D agendas.</li> <li>Precise attention to detail, but is also aware of how the big picture relates to company goals, and where the field of Machine Learning is headed towards.</li> <li>Understanding of the modern Machine Learning stack, for example:<br>- Knowledge of contemporary transformer architectures (e.g., GQA, KV-caching) and best practices.<br>- Experience in distributed training techniques.<br>- Familiarity with optimisation strategies for model inference (e.g., dynamic batching, flash attention, speculative decoding).</li> <li>With preferred backgrounds covering <span style="text-decoration: underline;">some</span> of the following:<br>- Publications in top-tier conferences.<br>- Contributions to popular open-source repositories.<br>- Technical writing skills as evidenced by relevant publications or blogs.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak">We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.</span></em></p> <p><strong>Who we are:</strong></p> <p class="p1">Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.</p> <p class="p1">Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.</p> <p class="p1">We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.</p> <p class="p1">This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What we can offer you:<br></strong></p> <p class="p1">No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.</p> <p class="p1">We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.</p> <p><strong>At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there.</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are.&nbsp;We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.</p> <p>But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.</p> <p><strong>So, come as you are and join our Speechling community.</strong> We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.</p> <p>For more information on us<sub>,&nbsp;</sub>please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.speechmatics.com/">our website</a> and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/Speechmatics/">Twitter</a>, <a href="https://www.facebook.com/speechmatics/">Facebook</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/speechmatics/">LinkedIn</a>, and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaZUN77-Wq0XQg5ICHLxKVw/">YouTube.</a></p> <h5><strong><em>We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment.&nbsp;</em></strong></h5> <h5><span style="color: #ffffff;"><strong>#LI-Hybrid</strong></span></h5></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Fospha - Click Z Graduate Content and Audience Strategist
description: <p>Do you follow every shift in digital marketing, media and commerce, and always have a view on which stories matter the most?</p> <p>Do you want to create content across channels that educates the next generation of marketers?</p> <p>Does the idea of shaping the content for one of digital marketing's longest-running publications excite you?</p> <p><strong>If so, we'd love to hear from you!</strong></p> <hr> <h2>About us</h2> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <p><strong>About ClickZ</strong></p> <p><a href="https://clickz.com/">ClickZ</a> is Fospha's media partner and one of the world's longest-running digital marketing publications, trusted by CMOs and senior marketers since 1997. Its focus is how measurement shapes marketing decisions, and it covers the wider marketing that measurement informs. Readers come to ClickZ to understand:</p> <ul> <li>How marketing leaders build teams, explain results to finance and earn influence in the room</li> <li>Retail and commerce marketing, including retail media and marketplaces</li> <li>How AI, search and ad platform changes affect planning and results</li> <li>Where to invest across brand, creative, performance, affiliate and influencer marketing</li> <li>How brands measure performance, from attribution and incrementality to mix modelling</li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>This is a permanent role at the heart of ClickZ. You'll run the day-to-day content engine: spotting the stories that matter to marketing leaders, turning them into sharp content across email, social and the website, and growing the audience that reads it.</p> <p>The work is varied. In a single week you might cover a session at a major commerce event, publish a piece on a platform change, prepare a leadership Q&amp;A, and review a stack of contributor pitches. You'll also build ClickZ's network of event partners, contributors, PR contacts and industry leaders, and meet many of them in person at industry events.</p> <p>You'll work closely with ClickZ's lead, who sets the brand's strategy, and you'll have real ownership of your workstreams from the start. This is an <strong>office-based role</strong> in London.</p> <p>This role suits someone with a journalist's instinct for a story, a marketer's eye for an audience, and the energy to keep both going every week.</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>What you'll work on</h2> <p>Your time will be spread across three areas, with content creation at the core. All three serve one goal: growing the ClickZ brand and getting its content to more of the right people.</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Focus area</th> <th>What it covers</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td>Content creation</td> <td>The core of the role: editorial content on market trends, event coverage, brand leadership interviews and Q&amp;As, flagship newsletters, and social content</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Audience growth and content analysis</td> <td>Growing ClickZ's readership and subscribers, testing new formats, and using performance data to decide what to create next</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Network and community</td> <td>Building relationships with event partners, marketing and commerce leaders, PR teams and contributors, online and in person at industry events</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Keep the content engine fed.</strong> Track the news and trends that matter to marketing and commerce leaders, and turn them into timely, well-argued content.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on every channel.</strong> Bring a creative eye to email, social and web content, and build a distinct content plan for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Shape the flagship newsletters.</strong> Draft and refine ClickZ's flagship newsletters, and develop more tailored formats for different parts of the audience.</li> <li><strong>Bring leadership conversations to life.</strong> Prepare and support podcast and Q&amp;A conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce, and, with training and support, grow into hosting them.</li> <li><strong>Grow the audience.</strong> Work out which formats and topics readers respond to, and turn readers into subscribers. Design campaigns that bring back readers who've gone quiet.</li> <li><strong>Let data inform the calls.</strong> Track what content delivers, use the numbers to decide what to do next, and share what's working.</li> <li><strong>Be the first filter.</strong> Review PR pitches and contributor submissions, and pick out the strong and relevant ones.</li> <li><strong>Build the network.</strong> Reach out to contributors, speakers and event partners, grow an always-on contributor community, and build lasting relationships with PR teams and industry leaders.</li> <li><strong>Get out into the industry.</strong> Attend events, support event partnerships, and find new events worth ClickZ's time.</li> <li><strong>Work agentically.</strong> Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting and multimedia content, while owning the quality of what goes out.</li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>What are we looking for?</h2> <p>We hire for potential and taste. You should apply if you meet these six must-haves:</p> <ul> <li>Have around one year of experience creating content in the digital marketing, media or commerce world, whether in journalism, editorial, content or social roles (internships, placements and personal projects count), and a genuine passion for digital marketing and commerce, and for the leaders shaping them</li> <li>Have <strong>strong editorial judgement</strong>: you can tell good content from weak, and relevant from noise, and you know a big story when you see one (experience of writing, editing or curating, including student or personal publications)</li> <li>Bring a <strong>creative eye to content</strong> across email, social and web, with a feel for multimedia formats</li> <li>Are <strong>audience-minded</strong>: you think about who's reading, how to reach more of the right people and how to build a community around a brand. You're also comfortable with data: you use performance numbers to make content decisions and back up your conclusions (experience using analytics such as GA4)</li> <li>Are <strong>agentically minded</strong>: you love experimenting with new tools for multimedia content creation and adaptation, and know when to push them and when to take over</li> <li>Are <strong>a natural conversationalist</strong>: you get a guest talking, hold your own with senior leaders, and leave an event with new connections</li> </ul> <p><strong>Also important:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have <strong>high agency</strong>: you take ownership of your work, stretch beyond the brief and challenge the status quo when something could be better</li> <li>Enjoy a fast-paced, innovative startup environment, where you'll ship quickly, iterate often and juggle several projects at once</li> <li>Are happy to travel for industry events, within the UK and occasionally overseas</li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>Our Values and Principles</h2> <p>You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Seek inclusion &amp; diversity:</strong> We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard</li> <li><strong>Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together:</strong> We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact</li> <li><strong>Grow:</strong> We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure</li> <li><strong>Customer at the heart:</strong> We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems</li> <li><strong>Candour with caring:</strong> We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude</li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>What we can offer you</h2> <ul> <li>Salary: £34k + discretionary 10% bonus</li> <li>Ownership of content for a media brand that has covered digital marketing for nearly 30 years</li> <li>Early ownership of your workstreams, and the chance to shape how modern marketers learn and make decisions</li> <li>A growing network across PR teams, contributors and industry leaders</li> <li>Hands-on podcast experience, with regular conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce</li> <li>A place at major industry events, with a front-row view of commerce, media and digital marketing</li> <li>Be part of a leading global venture builder, <a href="https://blenheimchalcot.com/blog">Blenheim Chalcot</a>, and learn from the incredible talent in BC</li> <li>The right mix of challenges, learning and development opportunities</li> <li>A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%</li> <li>A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!</li> <li>Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps</li> <li>25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)</li> <li>Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one</li> <li>Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&amp;S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more</li> <li>Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance</li> <li>Paid volunteering days each year</li> <li>Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch &amp; Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community</li> <li>Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices</li> </ul> <p><em>Top tip: Share two or three pieces of content you're proud of, and tell us one story ClickZ should cover next, and why.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.&nbsp; You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing&nbsp;<a ---------- but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for.&nbsp;You can review our privacy policy<a href="https://www.blenheimchalcot.com/recruitment-privacy-policy/">&nbsp;here</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Business Development Manager - AI Native
description: <h2><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD:</strong></h2> <p>NexGen Cloud is the company behind Hyperstack, a full-stack AI cloud serving tens of thousands of customers from AI researchers to enterprises running the world's most compute-intensive workloads. We deliver on-demand and private GPU infrastructure to teams who treat performance as a requirement, not a feature.</p> <p>We're a tight-knit, fast-moving team working at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure. We practice what we preach, equipping our people with AI at every level so we can solve harder problems, ship faster, and keep raising the bar for what enterprise GPU infrastructure looks like.</p> <h2><strong>THE ROLE: Senior Business Development Manager – Vertical Markets</strong></h2> <p>Hyperstack already runs production GPU capacity at scale for AI start-ups, AI service providers and enterprise AI teams. Proven ability to manage toward business KPIs, retention goals, customer health, and customer advocacy metrics. Experience identifying customer risk and contributing to retention, renewal, and growth strategies. Skilled at building credibility and relationships across multiple levels, from daily platform users to Director, VP, and executive stakeholders. Confident independently leading strategic customer conversations, including success planning, business reviews, executive conversations, and roadmap discussions. Comfortable translating customer goals into actionable creator marketing and platform strategies with measurable outcomes. Able to use customer, adoption, and performance data to identify risk, uncover opportunities, and tell compelling stories. Strong strategic thinker who can also manage the day-to-day execution and follow-through required to move customer initiatives forward. Highly organized, proactive, and self-directed, with the ability to effectively manage a portfolio of complex enterprise customers while working independently. A can-do, solutions-oriented mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Collaborative and experienced working cross-functionally with teams such as Implementation, Support, Product, Services, Insights, and Sales. Fluent French required, with strong professional English communication skills. Additional European languages are a plus. Based in Paris or within reasonable commuting distance and comfortable working independently as part of a distributed European team. Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us. Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave. Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program. Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more. Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. raw.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role

We are looking for a Production Quality Control Engineer to ensure product conformity, reliability and quality throughout the manufacturing process.

You will work closely with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain teams to implement robust quality controls across mechanical, electronic, and electromechanical assemblies.

This is a hands-on role, combining shop-floor presence, inspection activities, and continuous improvement in a fast-growing industrial environment.


Role & Missions


Production Quality Control

  • Define and implement incoming, in-process and final inspection procedures.

  • Establish inspection plans, checklists and acceptance criteria.

  • Perform and supervise inspections, measurements and functional tests.

  • Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, BOMs and technical specifications.

  • Apply relevant IPC standards, particularly IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620.

  • Manage production non-conformities, rework and corrective actions.

  • Validate product conformity before production release and shipment.

Process Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and improve manufacturing quality control processes.

  • Conduct root cause analysis (8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa, FMEA).

  • Monitor quality KPIs, defects, rework and production yield.

  • Work with Engineering and Manufacturing to prevent recurring issues.

  • Support industrialisation and production ramp-up.

Documentation & Supplier Interface

  • Maintain inspection records, quality documentation and product traceability.

  • Define incoming inspection requirements for critical components.

  • Coordinate with Supplier Quality and Supply Chain on supplier-related issues.

  • Contribute to the development of the Quality Management System and compliance with ISO 9001 / EN 9100 requirements.


Candidate Profile

Requirements

  • Engineering degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Electronics or Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in Production Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Engineering.

  • Strong knowledge of inspection methods and manufacturing quality processes.

  • Good understanding of electronic assemblies, PCB integration and wiring harnesses.

  • Knowledge of IPC-A-610 and IPC-A-620 standards.

  • Ability to read engineering drawings, BOMs and technical specifications.

  • Familiarity with problem-solving methodologies (8D, 5 Why, FMEA).

  • Hands-on mindset, strong analytical skills and attention to detail.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in aerospace, defence, automotive or other high-reliability industries.

  • IPC certification (CIS/CIT).

  • Experience with mechanical and electronic assembly inspection.

  • Knowledge of ISO 9001 / EN 9100.

  • Experience supporting industrialisation and production ramp-up.

Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner. Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions. Build the company as well as the account Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts. Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions. Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it. Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity. Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints , including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules. Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions. Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability. Nice to have Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs. Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments. Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation. Missions 🚀

  • Superviser les entrées en relation et les diligences KYC (KYC renforcé, revues périodiques) avec escalade des profils les plus risqués à l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 pour validation
  • Garantir le traitement de 1er niveau des alertes de transaction et de filtrage (sanctions, gel des avoirs, PPE) et l'escalade des alertes documentée vers l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Piloter la gestion des comptes inactifs et le cycle de blocage, d'investigation et de clôture des comptes en lien avec l’équipe en charge de la LOD2

  • Exécuter les saisies et piloter le prestataire externe en charge des réquisitions judiciaires

  • Piloter les SLA par flux et s’assurer de leur respect
  • Piloter le prestataire externe et suivre la qualité du traitement des réquisitions judiciaires

  • Rédiger et maintenir l’ensemble des procédures et modes opératoires du département
  • Former et accompagner l'équipe sur le traitement des alertes de surveillance des opérations et à la rédaction des examens renforcés
  • Faire évoluer les outils et automatiser les traitements, en accompagnant l'équipe dans le changement
  • Participer à la consolidation des données pour les comités des risques

  • Structurer et automatiser les indicateurs de l'activité

  • Organiser l'activité selon les risques ; piloter les délais, les stocks et la qualité
  • Appuyer l'équipe sur les dossiers complexes et sensibles avant escalade

  • Tu as déjà piloté la remédiation de recommandations d’audit ou de contrôle
  • Tu sais traduire les exigences de conformité en pratiques opérationnelles claires

title: Digital Data AI Therapeutic Office Lead
description: Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous croyons en des solutions innovantes et en un environnement inclusif où collaboration et développement professionnel vont de pair. Dans le cadre du renforcement des capacités Digital, Data & AI (DDAI) au sein des activités de R&D Pharmaceutique , nous recherchons un(e) DDAI Therapeutic Office Lead Oncology pour accompagner les équipes Oncologie dans l'identification, la priorisation et le pilotage de leurs besoins digitaux, data et intelligence artificielle. Véritable partenaire stratégique, vous assurerez l'interface entre les équipes scientifiques et les experts Digital, Data & IA afin de maximiser la création de valeur des initiatives et garantir leur bonne adoption. Vos missions : Business Partner Oncologie Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des équipes Oncologie sur les sujets Digital, Data & IA. Comprendre les enjeux scientifiques et identifier les besoins métiers à forte valeur ajoutée. Accompagner les équipes dans la définition et la priorisation de leurs initiatives. Accompagnement de l'Aire Thérapeutique Oncologie Développer une relation de proximité avec les parties prenantes R&D Oncologie. Anticiper les besoins et promouvoir les opportunités offertes par les solutions Digital, Data & IA. Assurer la visibilité des initiatives et des projets stratégiques. Pilotage du Portefeuille Centraliser, structurer et suivre le portefeuille des besoins Oncologie. Identifier les priorités, risques, dépendances et opportunités de mutualisation. Contribuer aux instances de gouvernance et de prise de décision. Coordination & Création de Valeur Mobiliser les expertises adaptées pour répondre aux besoins des équipes. Assurer le suivi des projets jusqu'à leur adoption. Mesurer et valoriser les bénéfices apportés par les solutions mises en œuvre. Reporting & Gouvernance Fournir une vision consolidée de l'avancement des initiatives. Produire les reportings nécessaires au pilotage des activités. Escalader les risques et points de blocage auprès des parties prenantes concernées. Requirements Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés par l'innovation en santé, capables d'évoluer à l'interface entre les métiers scientifiques, la donnée et la transformation digitale. Formation : Diplôme Bac+5 en Pharmacie, Sciences de la Vie, Ingénierie, Data Science ou équivalent. Expérience : 5 à 15 ans d'expérience au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique, de la R&D ou du conseil Life Sciences. Une expérience directe en environnement R&D est fortement appréciée. Compétences : Excellente gestion des parties prenantes, capacité à interagir avec des leaders scientifiques et des directeurs R&D, pilotage de portefeuilles de besoins ou de projets, ainsi qu'une bonne compréhension des enjeux Digital, Data & IA. Une expérience en transformation digitale, gouvernance de portefeuille ou innovation data constitue un atout majeur. Langues : Anglais professionnel indispensable. La maîtrise du français est fortement appréciée. Benefits Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur . Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient. Exceller avec bienveillance Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune. Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya. About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As a Partnership Operations Intern, you will help turn partner relationships into repeatable growth. You will have real responsibility for making partners successful, helping opportunities move forward, and building the systems that allow our partner ecosystem to scale.

This is a very hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how partnerships and the indirect channel really work. You will work directly with a wide range of external actors, including agency and consultancy leaders, partner sales and delivery teams, technology partners, and customers, while collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product at Dust.

You will not be limited to observing or executing a narrow checklist. You will own projects, see their impact, and help shape how Dust works with partners from the ground up.

What you'll do

Keep partners moving and growing

  • Animate the partner community through regular updates, follow-ups, check-ins, and activation initiatives.

  • Support partner onboarding and help partners find the right information, people, and resources at the right time.

  • Reply to partner questions and requests promptly, with clear next steps and strong follow-through.

  • Keep partner records, documentation, trackers, and workflows accurate and up to date across HubSpot, Introw, and Crossbeam.

  • Help design and improve scalable partner infrastructure, including onboarding flows, partner tiering, enablement tracking, and partner activity monitoring.

  • Track partner KPIs and help maintain dashboards covering activation, pipeline, attribution, engagement, and performance.

  • Identify recurring friction points and turn them into clearer processes, automations, or reusable resources.

Turn partner opportunities into revenue

  • Support partners throughout the deal creation process, from the first opportunity to a qualified pipeline item and a closed deal.

  • Create quotes and coordinate the information needed to move deals forward accurately and quickly.

  • Help maintain clean deal registration and partner attribution workflows in HubSpot.

  • Use tools such as Default, n8n, and Dust to reduce manual steps and improve visibility across the deal lifecycle.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Compliance Officer, you will be the dedicated owner of third-party due diligence and the broader integrity compliance agenda at Harmattan AI. You will protect our ability to operate and win contracts with demanding customers and partners as we scale across Europe, the US, the Middle East and Africa. You will build this function from the ground up, with real ownership and direct access to management. Responsibilities Own the third-party due diligence process end to end, covering partners, intermediaries, suppliers, prospects and investors. Screen incoming requests, assess the risk and issue clear go / no-go / go-with-safeguards recommendations. Define the risk-tiering methodology, screening tools and approval workflow that every due diligence file runs through. Build and maintain the group compliance risk map and a multi-year compliance roadmap. Draft, update and roll out group policies on anti-corruption, gifts and hospitality, conflicts of interest and whistleblowing. Design and deliver compliance training and awareness for employees and managers. Partner with Sales, Procurement and Legal on live files and contract clauses, escalating sensitive cases to management. Support the trade compliance function on end-use checks, and prepare evidence for audits, customer questionnaires and investor due diligence. Monitor anti-corruption and sanctions developments and turn them into practical guidance for the business. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

Vous aimez la diversité des sujets, la proximité avec la Direction et les équipes, les échanges directs. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris or Barcelona area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

#LI-DNP

title: Product Frontend Engineer
description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account. The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components. The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device. Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native. The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished. Where design ends, engineering begins. We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you. Requirements Who we are looking for You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed. You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building. You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels. You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does. Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action. This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us.

The Role

You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role.

This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone.

What You Will Do

  • Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships.

  • Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps.

  • Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

  • Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is.

  • Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks.

  • Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes.

  • Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination.

Who You Are

  • A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle.

  • Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched.

  • Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers.

  • A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity.

  • High ownership and bias toward action.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others.

  • Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out.

  • Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck.

  • A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too: Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering.

  • Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience.

Requirements

  • Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate.

  • Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia.

  • Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles.

  • Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred.

At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change.

We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence.

With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success.

title: Chief Financial Officer
description: Most CFOs inherit a finance function. This one gets to build it. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where we stand Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round. We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone. That is the opening. Tasks What you will own Everything financial: Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time. Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage. The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded. A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise. You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision. There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly. The first year Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design. You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream. You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers. By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months. Requirements Who we are looking for You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it. You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business. You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter. Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally!
